title: Phishing Proxy
author: NTT Security - Axel Olsson, Amata Anantaprayoon, Patrik Olson
description: A phishing proxy typically relays the same requests/responses as the legitimate site, while also intercepting credentials and/or session cookies. This rule detects HTTP requests that are part of login flows on sites that are common in a corporate environment. It can also detect a subdomain pattern commonly used by EvilProxy.
